name: CSV to JSON Converter
description: Convert CSV to JSON instantly, correctly handling quoted fields with embedded commas, quotes, and newlines — not a naive comma-split.

faq.question: Does this handle fields that contain commas?
faq.answer: Yes — a field properly quoted like "Doe, Jane" is parsed as one value, not split into two. This tool uses a real CSV parser (per the RFC 4180 convention: quoted fields, "" for an escaped quote, embedded newlines inside quotes) rather than a naive split on every comma, which breaks on exactly this kind of real-world data.

faq.question: What happens if I uncheck "First row is a header"?
faq.answer: The output becomes an array of arrays (one array per CSV row) instead of an array of objects — useful when your CSV has no header row to derive property names from.
